themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across multiple countries are intensifying calls for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, often framing these as essential for national security and economic stability. This theme reflects a shared rhetorical strategy to appeal to domestic constituencies by emphasizing sovereignty and exclusionary measures.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands national priority in housing and social services, criticizing regional governments for failing to enforce these policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes stricter immigration controls and prioritization of French citizens in welfare and employment policies.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for policies that prioritize Swedish citizens in housing, healthcare, and social benefits, often targeting immigration.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Pushes for 'national priority' in social housing and welfare, proposing bans on foreign nationals accessing these services.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Promotes policies favoring Norwegian citizens in welfare and employment, often linking these to immigration control.

themes.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal dominates global discourse
themes.blurb: The announcement and subsequent reactions to the U.S.-Iran peace deal have dominated right-wing and far-right news coverage, with leaders positioning themselves in relation to the agreement. This theme highlights the geopolitical focus of these groups and their attempts to frame the deal in ways that align with their domestic agendas.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration promotes the deal as a transformative step for regional stability, emphasizing its role in reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni expresses cautious support for the deal, emphasizing Italy's role in ensuring regional security and stability.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes the deal as insufficient, arguing it fails to address broader security concerns and Iran's regional influence.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Focuses on the deal's implications for Poland's security, particularly in relation to NATO and U.S. commitments.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes the deal as a capitulation to Iran, arguing it undermines Western security and emboldens adversaries.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in several countries are experiencing internal divisions, often centered around leadership challenges, policy disagreements, or strategic missteps. These divisions reflect broader struggles within these movements to maintain cohesion while navigating electoral pressures and shifting political landscapes.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega faces internal dissent over Salvini's leadership, with factions pushing for greater regional autonomy and policy shifts.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal divisions emerge over Adorni's leadership and Milei's economic policies, with allies questioning the government's direction.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Internal conflicts arise over Farage's leadership and party strategy, with defections and public disagreements.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz faces internal criticism over Orbán's leadership and the party's future direction, particularly after electoral setbacks.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Internal tensions over leadership and policy direction, particularly regarding alliances with other right-wing parties.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Coverage of Argentine President Javier Milei's declining approval ratings and internal government strife has resonated across right-wing and far-right media. This theme highlights the challenges facing populist leaders as they attempt to implement controversial policies while maintaining public support.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government faces declining approval due to economic policies and internal conflicts, particularly over Adorni's leadership.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. right-wing media highlights Milei's struggles as a cautionary tale for populist leaders, emphasizing the risks of unpopular policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Milei's economic policies and internal conflicts, positioning itself as a more stable alternative for right-wing voters.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing media discusses Milei's challenges as part of broader debates about populist governance and economic reform.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish right-wing media uses Milei's struggles to critique liberal economic policies and highlight the risks of populist leadership.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across multiple countries are reacting to ongoing conflicts in the Middle East, often framing these events in ways that align with their broader ideological agendas. This theme reflects the transnational nature of these groups' geopolitical concerns and their attempts to shape public opinion on international issues.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Promotes U.S. policies in the Middle East, particularly regarding Iran and Israel, framing these as essential for regional stability.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes French involvement in Middle East conflicts, arguing for a more isolationist approach and prioritizing domestic security.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports Italy's role in Middle East security initiatives, particularly in relation to the U.S.-Iran deal and regional stability.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Western involvement in Middle East conflicts, arguing for a more assertive stance against Iran and other adversaries.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Focuses on Poland's security concerns in relation to Middle East conflicts, particularly regarding NATO and U.S. commitments.
